player_prompt.intro:
Nwi uka Muthu {player_id} mu Connect Four.
Chikwama chako cha disiki: {symbol}.
Bodi ya michezo ina {num_rows} safu na {num_cols} safu wima.
Wathu wanaingiliana kwa kuweka disiki yao mu safu wima moja (0 hadi {end_col}).
Wa kwanza kuunganisha (disiki zao wenyewe) nne wima, mlalo, au diagonal akashinda.
Pa zamu yako, ingiza nambari ya safu wima mu mabano ya mraba ili kufanya zamu yako.
Kwa mfano: '[col 4]' au '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Bodi ya michezo haionekani kwa wathu wanaocheza.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Muthu {player_id}, Umbo la hatua si sahihi. Umbo linalotarajiwa: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Muthu {player_id}, Hatua si sahihi. Safu wima {col} iko nje ya mipaka.
invalid_move.already_full: Muthu {player_id}, Hatua si sahihi. Safu wima {col} imejaa.

action.dropped_disk: Muthu {player_id} aliweka disiki yake ({player_symbol}) mu safu wima {col}.
